questions.question: A 2:1 Mux using basic logic gates can be converted into a 2:1 Mux using only NAND gates, if:

answers.a: AND gates are replaced by NAND gates.
answers.b: OR gate is replaced by NAND gate.
answers.c: Both AND & OR gates are replaced by NAND gates.
answers.d: AND & OR gates replaced by NAND gates & NOT gate replaced by a NAND gate with both inputs tied together as single input

questions.question: To build a 2:1 using NAND gates (without enable), how many NAND gates are required?
To build a 2:1 using NOR gates (without enable), how many NOR gates are required?
